messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: euc2 ALB connection reset spike — automated thresholds crossed for 5xx rate and backend connection resets. Pager notified: oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: I'm awake, joining. Can someone paste the initial alert details? link to alert: https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/2901234567
sre-lee: seeing a 5xx surge from ALB(s) in euc2, multiple envoys showing upstream RSTs. Backend healthy on host checks, but ALB->envoy shows `connection reset by peer` in tcpdump.
eng-runtime-jamie: hitting increased request queueing on runtime pods in euc2c. KV-cache hit-rate normal. No recent deploys in the past 2h.
network-sam: checking infra — cloud console shows transient AZ euc2c ENI flaps around the same time. Routing table didn't change. Could be noisy NICs. Working with cloud provider ticket.
oncall-alex: customers impacted? product-ops-kate / cs-maria can we get quick churn estimate and top customers affected?
customer-success-maria: from support: ~14 tenants reporting timeouts and elevated error rates, mostly on EU region. I've opened a customer thread and DM'd affected account IDs to SRE.
eng-runtime-jamie: quick mitigation idea: shift ingress weight off euc2c ALB to euc2a/b while we stabilize. We can do weighted DNS via traffic-split for 10% increments.
network-sam: agree. Also suggest disabling ALB cross-zone routing for the problematic AZ temporarily and rely on healthy AZs. Will coordinate with infra console (requires 2-step change).
oncall-alex: do we have a fast fallback? Can we route traffic to NLB fronting envoy in euc2a/b? That would bypass ALB healthcheck behavior causing resets.
eng-runtime-jamie: NLB option ready but requires updating the ingress service annotation — low-risk. I'll open the PR and patch live if SRE signs off.
sre-lee: I'll start DNS weighted shift to pull 50% off the affected AZ first and monitor 1 minute buckets. If errors drop we keep shifting.
incidents-bot: Change requested by sre-lee: traffic-split weighted shift to euc2-other (50%). Change ID: CHG-290123-a — awaiting approval.
oncall-alex: approved. Do it.
sre-lee: applied weighted shift -> 50% now. Monitoring. :eyes:
eng-runtime-jamie: deploying NLB route as a hotfix path for euc2a/b. Patch submitted and applied: `kubectl patch svc ingress -n platform -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type":"nlb"}}}'` — watch for propagation.
network-sam: cloud provider ticket updated: suspected NIC hardware error in euc2c — they've scheduled a maintenance hop. Their networking team hitting us with updates.
incidents-bot: Monitoring rule: 5xx rate reduced by ~42% in last 2 minutes after weighted shift. Current global 5xx rate: 3.2% (was 5.8%).
product-ops-kate: good signal. Let's keep incremental shifts to avoid flapping. What's threshold for declaring customer-impact mitigated?
customer-success-maria: if 5xx < 1% for 10m and affected customers see healthy responses, we can mark as mitigated externally.
oncall-alex: set metric target: 5xx < 1% sustained for 10m. If we hit that, move to recovery and communicate to customers.
sre-lee: continuing to drain euc2c hosts and mark as unhealthy; ALB target-group health checks failing intermittent. I'll cordon the problematic nodes.
eng-runtime-jamie: NLB path is serving ~30% of ingress now and app latencies are stable on that path. No errors from NLB-routed traffic.
incidents-bot: Provider update: euc2c single-host NIC flapping — provider performing host replacement. ETA 8-12 minutes.
network-sam: I've submitted an automated route fallback to prefer euc2a/b for new sessions for 20m while provider remediation completes.
incidents-bot: Metrics: 5xx now 0.9% global. Rolling 10m window shows downward trend. Change CHG-290123-a closed.
oncall-alex: good. Start recovery play: reverse temporary changes once provider confirms stability. Keep NLB as warm standby.
product-ops-kate: prepping customer comms: brief note ready for affected tenants: impact summary, mitigation steps, ETA for follow-up postmortem. Maria take final review.
customer-success-maria: sending comms now to affected customers, noting expected full restoration once host replacement completes. cc product-ops-kate.
eng-runtime-jamie: once host replacement done, we'll run smoke: `curl -I https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/health` from multiple AZs and check 200 responses.
sre-lee: provider indicates host replaced and ENI stabilized at 10:42 UTC. Performing final health checks.
incidents-bot: Final checks: ingress 200s from multi-AZ probes ok, 5xx rolling 10m = 0.3%. Monitoring will continue. Incident status: mitigated -> under observation. :white_check_mark:
oncall-alex: great work team. Postmortem owner: sre-lee. Please capture timeline, root cause (NIC hardware flaps), and lessons (quicker DNS weighted playbook + NLB warm standby). Aim for draft in 48h.
sre-lee: taking postmortem. Will include runbook updates and a pre-approved weighted-shift playbook. ETA draft: 48h.
product-ops-kate: will prepare customer-facing post-incident summary once PM review.
customer-success-maria: following up with affected customers with the post-incident note.
incidents-bot: Incident closed to pagers at 11:05 UTC. This thread archived for postmortem drafting. :archive_box:
